description: ACT-INS-01, deciding variant: AutoNumber consumption by failed inserts. An (ID Counter primary key, Req Text NOT NULL, U Long unique) receives, with dbFailOnError and the table read after each: ('a', 1); ('b', 1) (unique failure); ('c', 2); (Null, 3) (required failure); ('d', 3); an explicit ID = 1 ('e', 9) (collision); then a plain ('f', 10) and ('g', 11). Follow-up probe (status F) for ACT-INS-01, SQL-CONTINUE; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
